aspectdrift.description: Controls how much zooming may change the aspect ratio before Id snaps it back to normal.

bailout.description: Overrides the escape bailout value used by escape-time fractals.

bailoutest.description: Selects the bailout test used to compare orbit values with the bailout limit.

bfdigits.description: Forces the number of arbitrary precision digits used when high precision math is active.

biomorph.description: Enables biomorph coloring and sets the color used for affected pixels.

center-mag.description: Sets the image area by center point, magnification, and optional stretch, rotation, and skew.

corners.description: Sets the image area by four rectangle bounds or six parallelogram corner coordinates.

fillcolor.description: Sets the block fill color used by boundary tracing and tesseral drawing modes.

finattract.description: Looks for finite attractors in Julia-type lakes and colors their basins when found.

formulafile.description: Selects the formula file used by type=formula fractals.

formulaname.description: Selects the formula entry used by type=formula fractals.

function.description: Selects variable functions for fractal types that expose function slots.

ifs.description: Selects the IFS entry used by type=ifs fractals.

ifs3d.description: Selects the IFS entry used by type=ifs3d fractals.

ifsfile.description: Selects the IFS file used by type=ifs and type=ifs3d fractals.

initorbit.description: Sets the complex starting value for Mandelbrot-type orbits or uses each pixel as the start.

inside.description: Selects the interior color or interior coloring method for points that do not escape.

invert.description: Enables inversion and sets the radius and center of the inversion circle.

ismand.description: Sets whether a formula treats the current orbit as Mandelbrot-style or Julia-style.

lfile.description: Selects the L-system file used by type=lsystem fractals.

lname.description: Selects the L-system entry used by type=lsystem fractals.

mathtolerance.description: Controls when Id switches from lower precision math to arbitrary precision during deep zooms.

maxiter.description: Sets the maximum iteration count before a point is treated as inside the set.

miim.description: Selects major and minor methods for MIIM inverse Julia generation.

orbitcorners.description: Sets the image-coordinate rectangle or parallelogram used for orbit drawing.

orbitdelay.description: Delays orbit plotting so initial orbit points can settle before display.

orbitdrawmode.description: Selects rectangular, straight-line, or function-based drawing for orbits.

orbitinterval.description: Plots every nth orbit point when using passes=o.

orbitname.description: Selects the orbit algorithm used by Julibrot fractals.

outside.description: Selects the exterior color or coloring method for points that escape.

params.description: Sets the extra parameter values consumed by the selected fractal type.

passes.description: Selects the drawing algorithm used to calculate the image.

periodicity.description: Controls periodicity checking, including off, show caught points, or a numeric tightness.

potential.description: Enables continuous potential coloring and sets max color, slope, modulus, and 16-bit storage.

proximity.description: Sets the close-proximity threshold used by inside=fmod and outside=fmod coloring.

reset.description: Resets calculation-related parameters to defaults for a parameter-file image entry.

rseed.description: Sets the random-number seed so random image output is reproducible.

screencoords.description: Keeps orbit screen coordinates fixed while the image coordinates zoom, rotate, or skew.

showdot.description: Displays the current pixel with a chosen or automatic color and optional pointer size.

showorbit.description: Starts image generation with orbit display enabled.

symmetry.description: Forces the drawing symmetry used as a speedup for fractals that actually have that symmetry.

type.description: Selects the fractal type to calculate.
